description: Check whether the user's Precept Chrome extension is installed, active, and communicating with Precept. Automated outreach runs in the background of Google Chrome via this extension (no open tabs or DOM interaction needed). If the extension is not installed or inactive, the response contains instructions and a direct Chrome Web Store link for the user.
name: precept_get_extension_status

outputSchema.description: Status of the user's Precept Chrome extension

active.description: Whether the extension has communicated with Precept recently (<10 min)

chromeStoreUrl.description: Direct Chrome Web Store URL to install the extension

extensionVersion.description: Installed version of the Chrome extension

installed.description: Whether the Precept Chrome extension is installed

lastSeenAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last extension heartbeat check-in

message.description: Human-readable status summary and next action instructions

title: Get Extension Status
